name: EH3D-DESIGN-VERIFIER
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.2: early code. Integral verification of a design: a Rust library and command line that gather the results of the checks from a JSON file, check that every finding has a well-formed PHOENIX code and names its object, and give a verdict that keeps confirmed failures apart from inconclusive results (a required area that did not run makes the verdict inconclusive). The report is canonical, with a hash, and can be printed redacted with counts only. It has only run on data made by its own tests; it runs no check itself, does not read a design, and the comparison with a manufacturing profile and the review document are not written.
